title: Scalding hot chocolate burns at football stadium
setting: Football stadium terrace. Fan spilled scalding hot chocolate over hands and arms. Red skin, in severe pain.
verdictExplanation: Alert, responsive, stable observations. A minor superficial scald on hands/arms with no airway compromise. Not sick: simple burn management.

shared.circulation: Warm, well-perfused centrally. Affected area red and painful

history.history: Tripped over seats while carrying hot chocolate, spilled over hands 5 minutes ago
history.injuries: Superficial scalds on right hand and forearm

followUp.question: What is the correct first aid management for this minor burn?

options.text: Cool the burn under clean, cool running water for 20 minutes, then cover with a clean dressing (e.g. cling film)
Apply butter, toothpaste, or burn cream immediately to soothe the skin
Burst any blisters that form and scrub the wound to keep it clean
Call 999 immediately for a critical paediatric emergency

followUp.explanation: All burns must be cooled under clean, cool running water for a full 20 minutes. Cover with cling film or a sterile non-adherent dressing. Never apply butter, toothpaste, or fats (they trap heat). Never burst blisters. 999 is not indicated for stable, minor superficial burns.

levelFlags.cfaNotes: Cool the burn under running water for 20 minutes. Reassure, dress loosely.
levelFlags.erNotes: Cool the burn for 20 minutes. Assess depth. Cover loosely with non-adherent dressing or cling film. Discharge with advice if pain controlled.
